# SD13-E3-F6 deterministic Human Paladin level 1 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin level 1 chassis as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-1-only hybrid baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell selections, no
# spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no smite/lay-on-hands/divine-grace/mercy
# feature resolution, no alignment-target or healing-resource accounting. It adds only
# the minimum feat, equipment, and selected-skill posture needed to make the bounded
# level-1 hybrid chassis legible; the paladin class-feature and later spell burdens are
# intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to name as still blocking.
